description_en: Queries the details of a listener for a Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance
description_zh: 查询网络型负载均衡实例的监听详情
kebab_example: aliyun nlb get-listener-attribute --listener-id lsn-bp1bpn0kn908w4nbw0000@233 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetListenerAttribute

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to only precheck the request. Valid values:
true: sends a check request and does not query the listener details. Check items include whether required parameters are specified, the request format, and service limits. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): sends a normal request. After the check succeeds, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is directly performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会查询监听详情。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can generate the value from your client. Make sure that the value is unique across different requests. The ClientToken parameter supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance. 

You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html operation to obtain region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
网络型负载均衡实例所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

Cps.description_en: The maximum number of new connections per second that the listener can process in each zone (VIP). Valid values: 0 to 1000000. 0 indicates that no limit is applied
Cps.description_zh: 该监听在每个可用区（VIP）处理的每秒新建连接限速值。取值范围：0~1000000。0表示不限速

EndPort.description_en: The end port for all-port listening. Valid values: 0 to 65535. The end port must be greater than the start port
EndPort.description_zh: 全端口监听结束端口。取值范围：0~ 65535。结束端口的取值小于起始端口

IdleTimeout.description_en: The idle connection timeout period. Unit: seconds
IdleTimeout.description_zh: 连接空闲超时时间。单位：秒

ListenerDescription.description_en:
The custom listener name.

The name must be 2 to 256 characters in length, and can contain Chinese characters and letters. It can also contain digits, commas (,), periods (.), semicolons (;), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
ListenerDescription.description_zh:
自定义监听名称。

长度限制为2~256个字符，支持中文和英文字母，可包含数字、半角逗号（,）、半角句号（.）、半角分号（;）、正斜线（/）、at（@）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）

ListenerPort.description_en: The listener port. Valid values: 0 to 65535. 0: indicates that all-port listening is used. When this parameter is set to 0, you must configure StartPort and EndPort
ListenerPort.description_zh: 监听端口。取值范围：0~65535。0：表示使用全端口监听。当设置为0时，您需要配置StartPort和EndPort

ListenerProtocol.description_en: The listener protocol. Valid values: TCP, UDP, and TCPSSL
ListenerProtocol.title_en: 监听协议 (TCP, UDP, TCPSSL, GENEVE)
ListenerProtocol.title_zh: 监听协议 (TCP, UDP, TCPSSL, GENEVE)

ListenerStatus.description_en:
The current status of the listener. Valid values:

Provisioning: The listener is being created.

Running: The listener is running.

Configuring: The listener is being configured.

Stopping: The listener is being stopped.

Stopped: The listener is stopped.

Starting: The listener is being started.

Deleting: The listener is being deleted.

Deleted: The listener is deleted
ListenerStatus.description_zh:
当前监听的状态，取值：

Provisioning：创建中。

Running：运行中。

Configuring：配置中。

Stopping：停止中。

Stopped：已停止。

Starting：启动中。

Deleting：删除中。

Deleted：已删除

Mss.description_en:
The maximum segment size (MSS) of a TCP packet. Unit: bytes. Valid values: 0 to 1500. 0 indicates that the MSS value of user TCP packets is not modified.

This field is supported only by TCP and TCPSSL listeners
Mss.description_zh:
TCP报文的最大段大小。单位：字节，取值范围：0~1500。0表示不修改用户TCP报文的MSS值。

仅TCP、TCPSSL类型的监听支持该字段值

SecurityPolicyId.description_en:
The security policy ID. System security policies and custom security policies are supported.

System policies: tls_cipher_policy_1_0 (default), tls_cipher_policy_1_1, tls_cipher_policy_1_2, tls_cipher_policy_1_2_strict, and tls_cipher_policy_1_2_strict_with_1_3.
Custom security policies: Enter the ID of the custom security policy.
    - To create a custom policy, see [CreateSecurityPolicy]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/445901.html）.
    - To query security policies, see [ListSecurityPolicy]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/445900.html）.

This parameter takes effect only for TCPSSL listeners
SecurityPolicyId.description_zh:
安全策略ID。支持系统安全策略和自定义安全策略。

系统策略取值：tls_cipher_policy_1_0（默认值）、tls_cipher_policy_1_1、tls_cipher_policy_1_2、tls_cipher_policy_1_2_strict或tls_cipher_policy_1_2_strict_with_1_3。
自定义安全策略：输入自定义安全策略ID。
    - 创建自定义策略，请参见[CreateSecurityPolicy]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/445901.html）。
    - 查询安全策略，请参见[ListSecurityPolicy]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/445900.html）。

仅对TCPSSL监听生效
